history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

classes-18.description: Every class twice: 18 fresh seeds, 100,000 engine turns, classes dealt and races cycled as in classes-1800. A smoke suite for assigned births.

experiment.description: On borg-reborn-rs main e85b80e1, how long should a Borg heading to town explore for an up staircase (caution_rising_explore_ticks 0, 150, 300, 600)? Generated from definitions/reborn-rising-ticks-pilot.yaml: 4 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-e85b80e1, suite classes-18.
experiment.name: reborn-rising-ticks-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: the owner asked to tune caution_rising_explore_ticks with everything else at the shipped defaults, pilot first (borg-zoo#191, from borg-reborn-rs#483 / PR #489). Small only after the pilot gate and the owner (RULES 14).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#191). Pilot only (RULES 14); small and larger only
after this gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's borg.txt has
borg_param_caution_rising_explore_ticks at its value and otherwise the shipped settings, no plan; every
cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn stalls and key outliers listed; in ticks0 none
of #489's notes ("no up stairs found, exploring for them (rising)", "Holding a descent while rising to
town") appear (fix-off check, on the death replays' messages). Descriptive, per arm: deaths, final
level, deepest level, town visits; Trip: return decisions and how many reached town; down-then-up
bounces (DL n -> n+1 -> n); counts of the two #489 notes and of "no up stairs found, going down";
paired rescued and newly killed against ticks0 on the same start. ticks300 is the shipped value. 18
starts per arm cannot show which budget is best. Known and not addressed: the scary-level flee taking
a down staircase while not heading home (borg-reborn-rs#488).
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main e85b80e1, how long should a Borg heading to town explore for an up staircase (caution_rising_explore_ticks 0, 150, 300, 600)?
